# Third-Party Notices

The GIMP Tauri companion consumes the existing GIMP palette and SugarSubstitute
application artwork. Its ICO container preserves the original PNG bytes. Their
source revisions, hashes and generated paths are recorded in `manifest.toml`.
The companion assets include the project AGPL terms, this notice and manifest,
and the GIMP and SugarSubstitute GPL terms.

## GIMP Default theme

GIMP-theme card icons, action glyphs and numeric step buttons use unmodified GTK3-era [Adwaita](https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/adwaita-icon-theme) 3.38.0 symbolic artwork, attributed to the [GNOME Project](https://www.gnome.org/). The artwork is distributed under its LGPL v3 option; the upstream notice and complete LGPL/GPL terms are included in `licenses/adwaita.LICENSE.txt`. Source paths, pinned revision and asset hashes are recorded in the manifest.

The GIMP visual style adapts the Default theme's dark/light colors, GTK control
paint, labelled comboboxes, notebook states and compact dock geometry under GPL-3.0-or-later.
The source revision, exact paths and source hashes are recorded in `manifest.toml`;
the license is included in `licenses/gimp.LICENSE.txt`. GIMP controls use the
unmodified Vue 3.5.43 runtime under MIT (`licenses/vue.LICENSE.txt`).

## OpenPhoto PhotoPro interface

PhotoPro adapts OpenPhoto's medium-gray panel colors and compact control paint
under the MIT license. Source Sans 3 Regular and Semibold are distributed
unmodified under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The pinned source revision,
paths, asset hashes, and license texts are recorded in `manifest.toml`.

## SugarSubstitute bundled prompt tags

The complete Danbooru prompt-tag snapshot from SugarSubstitute is included in
`frontend/comfyui/ui/prompt_editor/assets/danbooru-tags.txt` under GPL-3.0-or-later.
Its pinned source revision and SHA-256 are recorded in `manifest.toml`; the license
is included in `licenses/sugarsubstitute.LICENSE.txt`. The browser build embeds
the dataset for built-in SugarPrompt tag completion.

Vendored runtime assets are recorded in `manifest.toml`, with licenses under
`licenses/`. The browser deployment includes this notice, the manifest, and
the applicable license texts.

## Adobe Spectrum 2

Copyright 2026 Adobe. All rights reserved.

Spectrum Web Components 1.12.5 supplies the Spectrum 2 visual style, with
official controls, including activation switches, and scoped Spectrum 2 foundations. Upstream component sources
are unchanged; SugarCubes adapters translate their APIs to shared presentation
contracts. The pinned repository and source paths are recorded in the manifest.
The Apache-2.0 repository license and ISC theme-package license are included as
`licenses/spectrum-web-components.LICENSE.txt` and `licenses/spectrum-theme.ISC.txt`.

Bundled dependencies include Lit, Lit Element, Lit HTML, Lit Reactive Element,
and Lit observers (BSD-3-Clause); Floating UI, focus-trap, and tabbable (MIT);
Internationalized Number (Apache-2.0); and focus-visible (W3C Software and Document
License). Their exact package versions, source paths, and complete license files
are recorded in the manifest. Package integrity is pinned in `package-lock.json`.

## SugarSubstitute Model Catalog and Suggestions

Copyright (C) 2026 Artificial Sweetener and contributors.

The attached model picker placement follows the reference's available boundary,
preferred dimensions, side selection, and margin policy. SugarCubes applies this
policy to graph and masonry fields through one typed placement owner.

The OpenModelDB catalog values, parsing and cache behavior, reviewed upscaler
recommendations, registered-provider suggestion planning and acquisition,
provider-neutral suggestion values, exact-family CivitAI discovery and alternate
curated-upscaler offers, thumbnail-content safety policies, model artifact and
version-family eligibility rules, highlighted-model inline completion, and secure
CivitAI credential commands, Windows DPAPI storage, explicit empty-picker context
eligibility, reviewed discovery/acquisition coordination, exclusive portrait
suggestions, preview loading and unavailable states, bounded indeterminate progress arcs,
provider-source menus, and the contained credential prompt are adapted from
SugarSubstitute under GPL-3.0-or-later. SugarCubes uses strict typed application
and domain owners with its shared catalog, prepared assets, and verified transfer
pipeline. Acquisition preserves exact-size and hash verification, reuse of installed
bytes, and version-suffixed collision names. SugarCubes reserves hidden sidecars
and publishes with exclusive hard links to preserve other writers' files.
Automatic metadata lookup, explicit missing-model lookup, and CivitAI download
preferences retain their independent reference defaults and policy boundaries.
Provider freshness preserves exact file evidence, confirmed misses, thumbnail
selection policy identity, and prepared-asset availability. Valid local images
retain precedence over automatic provider images.
Exact provider matches retain separate metadata and ordered associations. Catalog
labels follow provider order, with CivitAI images available as fallback. Cache
maintenance preserves other providers and the source ownership of borrowed images.
SugarCubes retains complete metadata activity leases through asynchronous provider
work and physical publication. Cancelled requests drain their blocking writers;
exclusive maintenance waits for committed catalog and freshness decisions.
CivitAI cache settings expose record and image usage, Clear thumbnails, Clear
metadata, and Refresh. Provider-specific decisions and retry ownership keep these
operations separate from user choices, local images, and other provider records.
Prepared image source and variant ownership follows the reference's separate
asset store. SugarCubes serializes publication with collection and retains every
persisted user, local, and provider owner, including older image references.
Unclassified legacy references remain protected. Cache usage counts shared
physical WebP bytes once for each origin.
The source revision, source paths and hashes, and adapted module paths
are recorded in the manifest. The complete license is in
`licenses/sugarsubstitute.LICENSE.txt`.

## Microsoft Fluent Web Components and Tokens

Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.

The browser runtime bundles official `@fluentui/web-components` 3.1.3 and

Prompt fields use the official Fluent TextArea and Adobe Spectrum Textfield

pinned revision is recorded in the manifest, and the complete license is in
